items.q: said you were very fast. You know, Zutty speaks so highly of your drumming but he speaks very highly of Sidney Catlett but may God rest his soul, Sidney used to say, "The greatest drummer he ever knew was Zutty Singleton". He learned everything from Zutty.

ctx.x: Yes, Jo, is the cymbal man but he says I have faster hands than him, that's what he says.

Yeah, well Zutty Singleton always said you were very fast. You know, Zutty speaks so highly of your drumming but he speaks very highly of Sidney Catlett but may God rest his soul, Sidney used to say, "The greatest drummer he ever knew was Zutty Singleton". He learned everything from Zutty. Big Sid.
Yeah, Zutty was a wonderful man.
